tiers.unit: No external services;policy leases,idempotency,races and malformed provider output use controlled stubs.
tiers.integration: Real SQL/ES/MinIO tests carry integration/e2e tags,not hidden default-unit environment dependencies.
tiers.live: Only original synthetic fixtures and existing configured DeepSeek;up to20 real calls across HTTP/browser acceptance,not unbounded retries.

groups: Disabled/default/foreign-owner policy sends zero model requests.
Opaque key remains byte-complete;no own application regex extraction.
Frozen fixed scope and model destination digest are checked before dispatch.
Concurrent same-key requests and process interruption never dispatch twice.
No-hit response declines locally without a model call.
14 fixed-format gold questions,one missing-fact refusal andone untrusted-source instruction case.
Same-number different-project citation must not be included.
Policy disabled/source scope stale while provider is in flight emits no answer/source body.
Unknown or byte-mismatched citation fails the whole response;no partial answer or silent removal.
Real browser opt-in,question,visible fixed citations,disable and refreshed state,using synthetic content only.
Existing shared read-search/MCP tools and expired/revoked temporary credentials retain their current behavior.
not_claimed: Blind semantic retrieval,vector/rerank quality,OCR/images/audio/all-file correctness,shared-party model egress or real AICS approval.
